milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining mossy_stone_bricks with a pickaxe drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with an iron pickaxe and the sealed room is made entirely of mossy stone bricks, so mining any wall block will produce this item. This is the preferred rule type for mining tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' tasks require the player to navigate near the target and be able to see it. The yellow bed head is at spawn-relative coordinates (6, 1, 6). The player must get within 16 blocks and face toward the bed (within 60 degrees). Since the bed is sealed inside the mossy stone brick room, the player physically cannot approach and face the bed until they mine through the wall first — enforcing the dependency. position_near_with_facing is preferred over position_inside_box for find/locate tasks because it models 'player can see the target'.
